title: PlanState
description: Live coordination state for the Valory orchestrator. Mirrors the work-decomposition tree's runtime: the task DAG, per-task status, dispatched workers, and result-file pointers. Persisted at plan/state.json so a long-running orchestrator survives compaction. See docs/agentic-architecture.md.

mission.description: One-line statement of the root ask this effort serves (mirror of plan/root.md).

current_phase.description: The sprint or phase currently being executed (e.g. 'G1-S1 (Sprint 25)').

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last reconciliation of this state against the plan tree.

tasks.description: The task DAG. Each entry is a level-3 task with its scheduling and acceptance state.

id.description: Canonical task id in the form G<goal>-S<sprint>-T<task> (e.g. G1-S1-T1).

sprint.description: The sprint this task belongs to (e.g. G1-S1).

status.description: Lifecycle status. A task with unresolved depends_on is not dispatchable.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must reach status 'done' before this task is dispatchable.

assigned_worker.description: The contributor agent dispatched against this task (e.g. senior-engineer), or null if unassigned.

verifier.description: The acceptance gate(s) for this task (e.g. 'SQE + Systems Engineer').

artifact_path.description: Pointer to the worker's result — an artifact directory or the source paths touched. Null until produced.

acceptance.description: Verdict from the review pipeline (the level-4 acceptance facet).

requirements.description: Requirement IDs this task implements, for traceability.

blockers.description: Why this task is blocked or failed, if applicable.
